enriched_description: Small sheepdog resembling a miniature collie with a long, double coat in sable, black, or blue merle with white and/or tan markings. Coat is abundant with a dense, soft undercoat and long, harsh outer coat forming a pronounced mane and frill. Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall. Head is refined with a flat skull and tapering muzzle. Ears are small, set high, and semi-erect with tips folding forward. Tail is long, well-feathered, and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown (blue in merles) with a sweet, gentle expression.

Large sheepdog with a silky, abundant double coat in sable-and-white, tricolor, blue merle, or white. Coat features a pronounced mane and frill around the neck, with abundant feathering on legs and tail. Body is elegant, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is long and lean with a flat skull and refined muzzle. Ears are set high, with the lower two-thirds carried erect and tips folding forward. Tail is long, carried low with an upward swirl at the tip. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown (blue in merles) with a sweet, intelligent expression.

Medium-sized herding dog with a double coat in black with white markings on the head, chest, legs, and tail tip. Coat is moderate in length, dense, and weather-resistant with feathering on legs and tail. Body is athletic, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is broad with a moderate stop and tapering muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, set wide apart, and carried erect or semi-erect. Tail is medium-length, set low, and carried low with an upward curve. Eyes are oval, medium-sized, and brown (one or both may be blue in merles) with an intense, focused expression. The breed's signature feature is its intense, penetrating stare used for herding.

Large, powerful Belgian cattle dog with a rough, dense, double coat in fawn, black, grey, or brindle. Coat is harsh-textured, approximately 2.5 inches long, with a distinctive beard, mustache, and eyebrows. Body is compact, well-muscled, and substantial with a short-coupled frame. Head is broad with a flat skull and strong jaws. Ears are set high, traditionally cropped to triangular shape, or natural and pendant. Tail is docked short or naturally short. Eyes are dark, oval, and set level with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its rough coat, distinctive facial furnishings, and powerful build.

Large, powerful German cattle dog with a short, dense, black coat with distinctive rust to mahogany markings on cheeks, muzzle, chest, legs, and above eyes. Coat is straight, coarse, and lies flat against the body. Body is robust, well-muscled, and substantial with a broad chest and powerful hindquarters. Head is broad with a flat skull and strong, broad muzzle. Ears are pendant, triangular, set high and wide. Tail is docked short. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an alert, confident expression. The breed's signature features include its black-and-tan coloration, powerful build, and confident demeanor.

Large shepherd dog with a medium-length double coat in black-and-tan, sable, or solid black. Coat is dense, straight, and close-lying with a thick undercoat. Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a distinctive sloping topline. Head is noble and clean-cut with a broad skull and long, strong muzzle. Ears are large, erect, pointed, and set high. Tail is bushy, reaches to the hock, and carried low with a slight curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its erect ears, sloping back, and noble, wolf-like appearance.

Medium-large dog with a short, smooth, glossy coat in black and rust, red and rust, blue and rust, or fawn and rust. Coat is sleek, hard, and lies close to the body. Body is muscular, compact, and elegant with a level topline and deep chest. Head is long and wedge-shaped with a flat skull and powerful jaws. Ears are traditionally cropped to erect points, or natural and pendant. Tail is docked short. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its sleek coat, athletic build, and distinctive rust markings on a dark background.

Small, compact German version of the Doberman with a short, smooth, glossy coat in red, stag red, black-and-rust, or chocolate-and-rust. Coat is sleek, hard, and lies close to the body. Body is sturdy, square-proportioned, and well-muscled with a level topline. Head is long and wedge-shaped with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are set high, traditionally cropped to erect points, or natural and pendant. Tail is docked short. Eyes are dark, oval, and alert with a fearless expression. The breed's signature features include its high-stepping hackney gait, compact size, and Doberman-like appearance in miniature.

Large, powerful Swiss breed with a short, dense, tricolor coat of black with rich red and white markings. Coat is double-layered with a dense undercoat. Body is substantial, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad and powerful with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, triangular, pendant, and set high. Tail is long, bushy, and carried with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an alert, gentle expression. The breed's signature features include its tricolor pattern, massive build, and distinctive white blaze on the face.

Large, powerful Swiss dog with a long, thick, tricolor coat of black with deep tan or russet markings on legs, white blaze on face, white chest, and white feet. Coat is moderately long, slightly wavy, and silky with a dense undercoat. Body is substantial, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad, deep chest. Head is broad and flat with a moderate stop and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, triangular, pendant, and set high. Tail is long, bushy, and carried low. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, gentle expression. The breed's signature features include its tricolor pattern, long coat, and gentle, dignified demeanor.
